findings.quote: I took the ratio of the two times directly
findings.note: This is the WRONG method: taking 8/4 = 2 is exactly mistakes[0], and the sidecar repeats the same phrase verbatim as that mistake's route. A student who took the ratio of times taps it and is told they went the right way, while the student who used d = half g t squared has no route that fits. It also puts two identical phrases on the same menu.
findings.fix: I used that distance grows with time squared

notes: Types checked and accepted: mistakes[0] concept (the belief that fall distance is proportional to time is a wrong physics belief, so concept over the entry's 'application' hint); mistakes[1] calculation (the route was right, the factor half was dropped, 128g/8g = 16); mistakes[2] distractor, flag looks honest since 2, 16 and 9 are the reachable wrong values and none is 12. Arithmetic re-checked: d1 = 8g, d2 = 64g, ratio 8.
